questions.question: Who among the following gave most of his preaching at 'Gridhrakuta'?

__
 
• After years of wandering and meditation, he attained enlightenment under a bodhi tree in Bodh Gaya, India.
 
• Following his enlightenment, Buddha began teaching his philosophy and path to enlightenment, known as Buddhism, to others.
 
• He traveled throughout northern India and Nepal, preaching and teaching in various places.
 
• One of the most significant places where Buddha gave his sermons was **Gridhrakuta**, or **Vulture's Peak**.
 
 
• It is said that Buddha spent many rainy seasons at Gridhrakuta, where he gave several important sermons, including the Lotus Sutra and the Heart Sutra.
 
 
 
• **Gridhrakuta **is located in **Rajgir, Bihar, **India, and is considered to be one of the most important Buddhist pilgrimage sites.
 
• The mountain is shaped like a vulture, hence its name, and is believed to be the site where Buddha preached his most important teachings.

In summary, **Gautama Buddha gave most of his preaching at Gridhrakuta, a mountain in Rajgir, Bihar, India, where he delivered many important sermons, including the Lotus Sutra and the Heart Sutra**.

questions.question: Which of the following is a protection component that limits the amount of current flowing through the circuit and establishes a certain amount of voltage?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Fuse**__.

__
 
• Fuse is a protection component that limits the amount of current flowing through the circuit and establishes a certain amount of voltage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fuse**

 
 
• Fuse is designed to break the circuit and stop the current flow when the current exceeds a predetermined value.
 
• The fuse can not be reset; whereas the circuit breaker can be reset.
 
 
 
• Circuit Breaker
 
 
• This consists of a bimetallic strip which, when it becomes overheated from excessive current, bends away from a catch on the switch lever and permits the switch to trip open.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Switch
 
 
• A switch is an electrical component that facilitates a disconnect or conducting path in an electrical circuit.
 
 
 
• Earthing
 
 
• Earthing is the immediate transferring of electrical energy directly to the earth by the help of the low resistance wire.
 
• It is known as electrical earthing.
 
 
 
• Voltmeter
 
 
• It an instrument used for measuring the electric potential difference between two points in an electric circuit.
 
• It is connected in parallel manner.
 
• It has a high resistance so negligible current is consumed by the circuit.

questions.question: In which year did the Constituent Assembly set up a Drafting Committee under the Chairmanship of Dr. BR Ambedkar to prepare a Draft Constitution for India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1947**__.

__
 
• The **Constituent Assembly set up a Drafting Committee** under the Chairmanship of **Dr. BR Ambedkar** to prepare the **Draft Constitution for India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• On **29 August 1947**, the Constituent Assembly set up a **Drafting Committee under the Chairmanship of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar** to prepare a **Draft Constitution for India.**
 
• While deliberating upon the draft Constitution, the Assembly moved, discussed, and disposed of as many as **2,473 amendments out of a total of 7,635 tabled.**
 
• The Constitution of India was **adopted on 26 November 1949** and the hon'ble members appended their signatures to it on **24** **January 1950.**
 
• In all, **284** members actually signed the Constitution.
 
• On that day when the Constitution was being signed, it was drizzling outside and it was interpreted as a sign of a good omen.
 
• The Constitution of India came into **force** on 2**6 January 1950**.
 
• On that day, the Assembly ceased to exist, transforming itself into the **Provisional Parliament** of India until a new Parliament was constituted in**1952**.

questions.question: In which year did Government of India launch Total Sanitation Campaign (TSC) to accelerate sanitation coverage throughout the country, particularly in rural areas?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1999**__.

__
 
• In **1999**, the Indian government introduced the **Total Sanitation Campaign** (TSC) to accelerate sanitation coverage throughout the country, particularly in rural areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• It was implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development and the central government to "improve the general quality of life in rural areas.
 
• From 1999, a “demand-driven” approach under the “Total Sanitation Campaign” (TSC) was adopted.
 
• It emphasized the following:
 
 
• Information, Education and Communication (IEC)
 
• Human Resource Development (HRD)
 
• Capacity Development activities
 
 
 
• It increases awareness among the rural people and generation of demand for sanitary facilities. 
 
• This enhanced people’s capacity to choose appropriate options through alternate delivery mechanisms as per their economic condition.
 
• Financial incentives were provided to **Below Poverty Line (BPL)** households for the construction and usage of individual household latrines (IHHL) in recognition of their achievements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The TSC made some progress, but it suffered from its relatively low priority and its ineffective deployment of resources.
 
• It was renamed **Nirmal Bharat Abhiyan** in **2012** and relaunched as **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan **in** 2014**.
